name: Cosmic Perspective
body:
Discipline clairsentience (scrying); Level seer 7

MANIFESTING

Display auditory and visual
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECTS

Range see text
Effect psionic sensor
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Power Resistance no
Power Points 13

DESCRIPTION

This power functions as clairvoyant sense, save that supernaturally enhanced senses operate through the psionic sensor and the sensor is capable of moving at a speed of 60 feet per round. In addition, the sensor gains the ability to fly at phenomenal speeds, able to move between two planets within a solar system in 1d4 minutes and beyond that in 1d4 hours. The locations the sensor moves to need not be familiar ones, and this power is often used to explore uncharted territory throughout the universe.

Augment: If you spend 4 additional power points, you may manifest powers through the Cosmic Perspective as if you were in the location.
